new.name: cancel_run
new.source:
fn cancel_run(sim : Simulator, run : RunState) : Simulator =
  if terminal(run) then sim
  else
    let steps = map(\(step) -> if step.status == Pending then StepState { ..step, status = StepCancelled } else step,
      run.steps)
    -- A running step stays uncertain until a tick reconciles it by lookup.
    let status = if any(\(step) -> step.status == Running, steps) then Cancelling else RunCancelled
    replace_run(sim, RunState { ..run, status = status, cancel_requested = true, steps = steps })

fn select_action(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow) : Option(Action) =
  -- Resume the oldest in-flight attempt before scanning ready pending work.
  match select_run(sim.now, true, sim.runs, workflow.steps) of
    Some(action) => Some(action)
    None => select_run(sim.now, false, sim.runs, workflow.steps)
